text:
Maya: quick update: we flipped the "hot-prefix primer" on the raptor-7b canary pool about 3h ago. seeing measurable wins so far.
DevBot: canary deploy finished (logs: https://deploys.internal/rw/1745601000) :white_check_mark:
Kevin: can you paste the headline metrics?
Maya: headline: p50 latency -9.8% on a sampled chat workload, p95 -6%, token-level GPU+CPU cost down ~18%. throughput unchanged.
Jordan: any impact to cold-start or rare prefixes?
Maya: cold-start memory +~120MB/process and a +1-2ms start penalty for totally unseen prefixes. TTL evictions shrink that quickly; steady-state mem is fine. rare-prefix tail slightly worse but aggregate tail improved for normal traffic.
Anita: did you test long contexts (8k/16k)? any regressions?
Maya: ran the full seq-length sweep, long-contexts look neutral. no regression on our 8k/16k harness.
Maya: bench command we used:
```
./run_bench --model raptor-7b --workload chat-24k --iters 1000 --out results/hotprefix_priming_canary.json
```
Kevin: rollout plan? staged?
Maya: plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h with checkpoints at each step. gating metrics: p50/p95, prefix-evict-rate, OOM events. rollback if p95 regresses >3% or OOM spike. opening rollout ticket now.
Infra-Bot: created ticket RW-3137 (assignee: Maya)
DevBot: recommended watchlist: token-throughput, prefix-evict-rate, p50, p95, GPU-util, per-host mem-usage. Alerts: p95 increase >3% or evict-rate >2x baseline.
Jordan: ack. i'll run continuous A/B against the control pool and flag anomalies. :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks — i'll attach raw bench outputs and traces to RW-3137. will post a short follow-up if anything unexpected shows up.
